answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted beacon attestation: an agent must lock a refundable deposit before its quill-signed work counts toward reputation or payment. A rotating beacon committee samples recent work and slashes deposits tied to duplicate or fake identities, so creating thousands of sock puppets means locking thousands of deposits. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, influence grows only from sustained, verified contributions, making a large-scale fake-identity attack cost more than any reward it could extract.
